scope: Fresh anonymous access and Example Domain HTML extraction; this access task alone does not verify PDF extraction.
configuration: OpenCode1.18.35; DeepSeekV4.1Flash/high; execution25requests (access300s/business600s), grading40requests/300s,32000outputtokens/request. Same image,2GiB/1CPU/pids256,pipTUNA, initially emptycache; freshhome/session/workspace. Two service execution streams, separate fresh graders.
account: Anonymous only; no account, key, payment or mutable remote resource created.
limit_enforcement: Service extraction count and >=1s spacing are instructions; model request, output and time limits are enforced. Stop after two consecutive 403/429/connection failures. MCP initialize/notifications/list calls are not extraction calls but are recorded in tools/time.

service_cost_judgment.note: 匿名无 Key 属官方 keyless 免费档；本次调用符合其条件，未产生实付费用。匿名每日配额数值/余量未知，按回执 creditsUsed=1 记录但不计费。

applicability.rule: 官方文档：Keyless (no API key) 使用免费，按 IP 地址每日受请求数与 credit 数两个上限约束（firecrawl-rate-limits.md）；Scrape 等端点可在完全无 API key 的 keyless 免费档使用（firecrawl-billing.md）。
applicability.observed: 本次仅以 Content-Type 头匿名 POST /v2/scrape，无 Authorization、未提供 API key，返回 HTTP 200、success:true，属 keyless 免费档的正常使用。

fee_limit: Official anonymous free rules matched to actual anonymous requests by the independent grader. Remaining quota and provider billing statement unavailable; public free result does not establish unlimited access. Credits are separate from dollar charges.
public_selection: Only minimal factual observations, selected short table data and original evidence hashes. Full PDF, images, maps, raw service responses, complete sessions and request identifiers remain private.
resources: All four dedicated batch containers stopped after independent review and complete usage collection.
access_preparation: Anonymous connection configuration saved; no registration or supplied service-call code. Controller later audited and removed example response fields and old workspace pointers before the business task; access conclusions do not certify every executor-written config claim.
